name: Scroll Drift Image Grid
description: Sparse grid of square images that sway with scroll-scrubbed rotation and drift vertically at random speeds over a fixed centered cover title, ending on a text footer panel.
contents: Grid of square background images placed by row and column
Fixed cover title with superscript mark and subtitle
Full-height footer panel with a paragraph
behavior: Each image rotates around a far-off origin as it crosses the viewport
Each image cell drifts vertically by a random amount scrubbed to scroll
Footer panel slides over the fixed cover title
